from ns2 import NetworkSimplex
import time

def check(ns,name):
    pi=ns.potentials()
    print(name,'obj',ns.objective(),'iters',ns.iters,'degen',ns.degenerate)
    bal=[0]*K
    for i,(u,v,l,h,c) in enumerate(arcs):bal[u]+=ns.flow[i];bal[v]-=ns.flow[i]
    print(' balmax',max(abs(x) for x in bal))
    badf=badt=0;minrc=None
    for i in range(ns.E):
        l=ns.lo[i];h=ns.hi[i];x=ns.flow[i]
        rc=ns.cost[i]+pi[ns.fr[i]]-pi[ns.to[i]]
        if x<h and rc<0:badf+=1
        if x>l and -rc<0:badt+=1
    print(' violations fwd/back',badf,badt)
    neg=sum(ns.cost[i]*ns.flow[i] for i in range(ns.E) if ns.cost[i])
    print(' costsum',sum(ns.cost[i]*ns.flow[i] for i in range(ns.E)))

t=time.time();nsf=NetworkSimplex(K,arcs,f1);nsf.solve();check(nsf,'full')
